surfaces.part: sand shore tile with dark teal water pool

answer.evidence: This is a terrain autotile (lakeshore sand, mask 8). It fills a full 16x16 tile (width 16 on every row) with a sand border around a dark teal water area at about rows 3-12. The columns show sand, then water, then sand again, with no front face and no standing volume. It is a flat ground tile viewed from above, so there is no top-and-front structure to measure.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a tiny lakeside mask with a dark teal water blob and a thin tan sand rim. It uses only 9 colours in total, and 26% of it is near-flat by the 5x5 measure, which is the large teal area. The references have 0% near-flat. The sand has about 2-3 steps with no grain, speckle or per-pixel texture. The grass reference has dotted clumps in several greens, and the paving reference has stones shaded one by one. The 9 visible tones per tile beat the grass (3) and paving (7) numbers, but those tones sit in a few flat bands, not in texture, so by eye the piece looks flatter than both references. The edge pixels are tinted (0% neutral), so the outline is a dark material tone, which is fine. Shallow shading and flat fills outweigh that, so the piece fails.
